name: Frost Boudiaf
location: Old Harbor, near Lake Shore and Wacker

physical_description.heritage: A striking blend of East Asian (31.4%), Sub-Saharan African (28.1%), North African (24.3%), and Southeast Asian (16.2%) ancestry. The East Asian and Southeast Asian elements contribute angular cheekbones and a moderate nose bridge, while Sub-Saharan and North African heritage manifests in warm skin depth and prominent facial structure. Complex phenotype reflecting true cosmopolitan genetic signature of the Ubiquitous Diaspora—no single lineage dominates, creating balanced, multifaceted features.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and sturdy, with the weathered muscularity of someone who spent decades on water. Slight thickening at the midsection from age and desk work, but core strength evident in posture.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray, naturally darkening to charcoal at the roots
physical_description.hair_style: Slicked back and trimmed close at the sides, kept practical and functional
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium to medium-deep brown with warm golden undertones, reflecting the balanced blend of East Asian, Sub-Saharan, North African, and Southeast Asian heritage. Sun-darkened and weathered from years of harbor exposure, creating a rich, complex complexion with subtle warmth beneath.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, particularly around the eyes and forehead. Facial bone structure reflects the multilayered ancestry—prominent angular cheekbones, moderate nose bridge width characteristic of the genetic blend, subtle fullness balanced across the face. Jaw remains sharp despite weathering. Three-day stubble is his default grooming state. Crow's feet suggest a history of squinting into glare off the water.
distinguishing_marks: Faded anchor tattoo on left forearm, ink bleeding slightly with age
Surgical scar along left collarbone, approximately 8cm, from a dock accident in his thirties
Burn scar on the back of right hand, irregular shape, consistent with coolant splash
Deep vertical crease between eyebrows from decades of concentration and frowning
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Favors invisibility in his work.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with measured deliberation, economical gestures. Stands with weight balanced, feet shoulder-width apart—a harbor man's stance. Hands often rest on table or lap. Direct eye contact. Minimal facial expression; communication relies on tone and word choice rather than animation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear. Heavy canvas work jacket, navy or charcoal, with deep pockets and reinforced seams. Thermal undershirt. Worn denim or canvas trousers with tool loops. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and well-maintained. A simple titanium ring on his left ring finger—no wedding band, just a memorial marker. Occasionally wears a faded GLMZ Harbor Authority cap from a previous life. No visible corpo branding; clothes are functional, durable, replaceable.
